metadata.title: Vanishing Theorem of Pin(2)-equivariant Bauer-Furuta Invariants as Stable Sections
metadata.abstract: We develop a viewpoint of Pin(2)-equivariant Bauer-Furuta invariant: It can be converted to a section over a finite dimensional Pin(2)-orbit, and it takes values in ordinary stable homotopy class. This viewpoint reveals a topological limitation of the invariant: If the fiber's connectivity exceeds the dimension of the base space, then all sections are homotopic to the trivial section. We use it to recover Lin-Mukherjee vanishing theorem. Furthermore, the family Seiberg-Witten invariant can be obtained from the pullback of such sections to $S^1$-orbit. We use this fact to prove a vanishing theorem of the Pin(2)-equivariant family Bauer-Furuta invariant after two stabilizations.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Pin(2) 等变 Bauer–Furuta 不变量的截面消失
analysis.workSummary: 把 Pin(2) 等变 Bauer–Furuta 不变量改写成有限维 Pin(2) 轨道上的截面，用普通稳定同伦类处理。纤维的连通度超过底空间维数时，截面同伦于平凡截面。
analysis.breakthrough: 以截面观点恢复 Lin–Mukherjee 消失定理，并通过向 S¹ 轨道拉回关联族 Seiberg–Witten 不变量，得到两次稳定化后的 Pin(2) 等变族 Bauer–Furuta 消失定理。
analysis.limitations: 消失机制依赖纤维与底的维数比较。族定理的具体稳定化及适用数据需按正文核对。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第4页披露命题2.4的交换图、谱序列及引理3.1插图由作者先手绘，ChatGPT 6 Astra 转写为 LaTeX。基于 Codex 的知识导航工具 Qprint 用于新颖性核查。记排版和文献核查用途。第1页为目录，第13页为 Qprint 引文。
